body:
FORGE FINALE -- sessions 7-8: second checkbox earned, plus a real find

Also: the cloud /schedule option turned out to be a dead end -- it runs in an isolated cloud sandbox with no access to your local files, MT4, or Python, so it can't actually do this work. Didn't set it up. Continuing directly instead, which is working fine.

Session 7-8 (regime classifier ownership, same question as the threshold one): good news first -- this one turned out to already be well-designed. Two legitimate uses of the regime classifier (a fast raw read for scoring, a smoothed one for deciding when the regime has genuinely changed), and the code's own comments already explain which is used where. Mapped and confirmed -- second checkbox earned (13/45 now).

While checking that, found something bigger: there's a THIRD, previously-unknown scoring path that runs every ~1 second in real time (separate from the main per-bar engine) that can silently overwrite the live score when it thinks it sees an opportunity mid-bar. Its own code comment literally says "handled silently." Not measured or touched yet -- just surfaced, and it's now the top priority since it could matter more than anything found so far.

Continuing.
